title: Bumper Crop
survival_class: SURVIVAL DIFFICULTY CLASS 1; Exit 2/5 Somewhat Difficult to Exit; Environment 1/5 Low Environmental Risk; Entities 0/5 No Hostile Entities
physical_identity: Endless pasture of wheat and barley fields divided into plots by tree and shrub lines, under a permanently overcast sky, with lakes, barns, sheds and dirt tracks.
scale_topology: Infinite outdoor plain, flat; soil only one metre deep above a mass of worms; lakes below one consistent elevation.
anomalies: dirt tracks that do not regrow and bear no vehicles
soil one metre deep over writhing worms
lighting_sound: Overcast leaden sky, constant daylight, rare light rain and fog; wind gusts among crops.

entities.name: Soil worms
entities.behavior: Wormlike, below 1 m of soil; surge out if dug deeper

hazards: worm surge when digging below 1 m
items_communities: wood and nails in sheds and barns

entrances.quote: Walkways in Level 9 that lead to grass fields may lead one to this level.
you can find a back road that leads to Level 10
Enter via an arcade machine in Level 25.

exits.method: Follow a dirt road a prolonged distance
exits.quote: may eventually lead one to Level 11

exits.method: Enter a canola patch among the wheat
exits.quote: entering it will lead one into Level 184
Swimming into a lake can lead one to a number of aquatic levels

signature_mechanic: Calm endless farmland whose only danger is digging below a 1 m soil crust into a worm mass; unused vehicle tracks lead onward.
verticality: None; flat plain with single-storey barns.
conflicts_notes: Interleaved first-person family story mentions entering at Level 1 and passing 4,5,6,8; unreliable. Narrator says wheat never rots while article says it appears safe.

key_quotes.quote: an expansive pasture of wheat and barley fields stretching endlessly in all directions
no such vehicles have ever been observed on Level 10
only one meter deep before giving way to the mass of worms
Level 10 has no dedicated outposts within it
entering it will lead one into Level 184
